Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana

Administered by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.

Benefits

Insurance cover up to Rs. 50,000 per hectare against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests and diseases.

Eligibility

  • All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas are eligible.

Documents Required

  • Voter ID
  • Sowing certificate from the village officer

Enrolment for the current season: applications are closed. The last date was 31-07-2026.
